name: flash-backup
description: Copies the PCM's whole 64 MB flash (bootloader, system images and /HBpersistence) to the USB stick as pcm_flash.bin, plus the activation file and stored VIN next to it. Read-only -- it is the same read the PCM's own engineering menu does (CustomerService option 05), without needing the menu. Make one before any update or experiment, then check it on a computer with PCM-Explorer (python explorer.py pcm_flash.bin check). Never overwrites an earlier backup; a copy that comes out short (stick full) is deleted and reported. The file holds your VIN and activations, so don't post it. See RECOVERY.md.
author: dspl1236
